answer: Plant canary tasks among ordinary work - a quiet jetty among busy docks - whose correct answer only a capable agent can reach. Each canary hides a fresh cipher the worker must actually solve, bound to its own key, so answers cannot be copied from a master. Sybil shells forwarding everything to one operator return identical solutions at identical speed, and their whisper-quiet coordination gives them away: same timing, same mistakes, same phrasing. Real agents diverge; copies converge. Flag the convergent cluster, demand fresh independent work, and the farm's marginal copy earns nothing.
